title: QuadraticExt::mul Karatsuba SoA batched SIMD
description:
## Current

`gfpn::QuadraticExt::mul` (`crates/gf2-core/src/gfpn/quadratic.rs`) does Karatsuba (3 base-field multiplications + 2 additions per element). Scheduling is sequential; no SoA batched path.

## Fix

PPC walk:

- V2 ILP: schedule the 3 independent base-field muls across registers so they run in parallel (no false dependency chain). This step can ship before C3 lands.
- V3 SIMD batched: introduce a SoA `Vec<QuadraticExt<C>>` layout (separate `c0` and `c1` arrays); call into the C3 generic Fp batch path for each Karatsuba step. Stronger gains here require C3.
- Wire SoA scaffolding into `gfpn::compute` (new module if needed).

## Per-kernel execution protocol

Same as C1. Bench: `field_matrix_fusion.rs` (existing).

## Success criteria

- [hard] Bit-exact vs. existing AoS `QuadraticExt::mul`.
- [hard] AoS path unchanged and at least as fast (no regression for callers that do not use SoA).
- [hard] SoA path covers add, sub, mul, square (all four ops, not just mul).
- [aspirational] ≥1.5× geomean on `field_matrix_fusion` bench when both C3 (Fp batch) and C4 land.
